  Program Schedule Day 1,2,3: Modelling of Building using 3DS MAX. Day 4,5: Project Management using Primavera. Day 6: Setting out Building Plan on Ground. Day 7,8: Analysis & Design of Multi storey Building using Staad Pro. Day 9: Hands on Practice. Day 10: Site visit. Day 11: Contour & 3D mapping using Surfer. Day 12,13:   Site visit. Day 14: Hands on Practice. Day 15: Valedictory.
